sentences.ar: النهاردة بقى احنا هنفتح الصندوق الاسود للذكاء الاصطناعي هنفهم سوا إيه اللي بيحصل جواه بالظبط
sentences.en: Today we open the black box of AI and understand together exactly what happens inside it.

sentences.ar: من أول ما نحسب الـneuron الواحد بإيدينا كده لحد ما نوصل لـTransformer
sentences.en: From computing a single neuron by hand all the way to the Transformer.

sentences.ar: تصدقوني مفيش أي سحر هنا خالص الموضوع كله شوية حسابات وأرقام
sentences.en: Trust me, there is no magic here; it is all just calculations and numbers.

sentences.ar: جاهزين؟ يلا بينا أجندة الشرح بتاعنا سريعة جدا
sentences.en: Ready? Let's go; our agenda is very quick.

sentences.ar: هنبدأ بأساسيات الـneural network وبعدين هنشوف إزاي بنجهز النص للموديل
sentences.en: We start with neural network basics, then see how we prepare the text for the model.

sentences.ar: وندخل جوه Transformer وبعدها التنبؤ والـgeneration وفي الآخر مفاهيم الـLLMs الأساسية والـprompting بطبقاته
sentences.en: Then we get inside the Transformer, then prediction and generation, and finally the core LLM concepts and prompting with its layers.

sentences.ar: القسم الأول معنا أساسيات الـneural network أو نقدر نقول اللبنات الأساسية
sentences.en: Part one: neural network basics, or the basic building blocks.

sentences.ar: وزاي ما اتفقنا مفيش سحر كله math وبيانات
sentences.en: As agreed, there is no magic; it is all math and data.

sentences.ar: طب إزاي بنحسب الـneuron الواحد
sentences.en: So how do we compute a single neuron?

sentences.ar: الموضوع بسيط قوي المعادلة هي W مضروبا في X زائد B
sentences.en: It is very simple: the equation is W times X plus B.

sentences.ar: يعني بناخد الـinputs بتاعتنا زي مثلاً عدد طلبات العميل أو الـ LTV بتاعه
sentences.en: We take our inputs, for example the number of the customer's orders or their LTV.

sentences.ar: عشان الـneuron يطلع لنا رأيه في النتيجة في الآخر
sentences.en: So that the neuron gives us its opinion on the result at the end.

sentences.ar: طيب، تفتكروا ليه الـ Activation Function دي ضرورية؟
sentences.en: Why do you think the activation function is necessary?

sentences.ar: من غيرها ببساطة، الطبقات كلها هتنهار وهتبقى مجرد خط مستقيم
sentences.en: Without it, simply, the layers all collapse and become just a straight line.

sentences.ar: كيفك بتبدأ تتني ويتعمل منحنيات
sentences.en: It starts to bend and curves get formed (the opening words were lost in the audio).

sentences.ar: لو عندنا 3 inputs دخلين على 2 neurons يبقى معنا 6 weights زائد 2 bias كده 8
sentences.en: If we have 3 inputs going into 2 neurons, we get 6 weights plus 2 bias, so 8.

sentences.ar: ولما الـ 2 neurons دول يروحوا الـ output neuron 1 بنزود 2 weights و 1 bias
sentences.en: And when these 2 neurons go to the output neuron 1, we add 2 weights and 1 bias.

sentences.ar: يعني 3 كمان المجموع بالضبط 11
sentences.en: That is 3 more, so the total is exactly 11.

sentences.ar: شفتوا ازاي؟ لما بنعدهم بنفهم الشبكة بتتبني ازاي بالزبط
sentences.en: See how? By counting them we understand exactly how the network is built.

sentences.ar: عظيم جدا المودل بقى بيتعلم ازاي
sentences.en: Great. Now how does the model learn?

sentences.ar: اللفة دي بتبدأ بforward pass نطلع منه تنبؤ
sentences.en: This loop starts with a forward pass, from which we get a prediction.

sentences.ar: حجم الخطوة اللي بناخدها دي هو الـlearning rate
sentences.en: The size of the step we take is the learning rate.

sentences.ar: أول ما الـlearning rate يعدي 0 .35 المنحنى بيتشتت تماماً وينفجر
sentences.en: As soon as the learning rate passes 0.35, the curve scatters completely and blows up.

sentences.ar: إيه الحسابات بتبوظ والموديل بينهار
sentences.en: The calculations break and the model collapses.

sentences.ar: القسم الثاني تجهيز النص للموديل
sentences.en: Part two: preparing the text for the model.

sentences.ar: الشبكات دي ما بتفهمش كلام بتفهم أرقام بس
sentences.en: These networks do not understand words; they only understand numbers.

sentences.ar: فلازم نحول أي نص الأرقام الأول
sentences.en: So we must convert any text into numbers first.

sentences.ar: النقطة دي جوهرية جدا
sentences.en: This point is extremely important.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

referenced.ctx: Gradient descent diverges above a learning rate of about 0.35 — because the arithmetic diverges, not because it was scripted to.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: The basic unit of a neural network: it computes a weighted sum of its inputs plus a bias,…
concepts.failure: Forgetting the activation; without it stacked neurons collapse into one linear function.

concepts.def_en: The neural-network architecture behind modern LLMs: stacked attention and feed-forward blocks that read from and write to a residual stream, processing tokens in parallel.
concepts.def_ar: معمارية الشبكة العصبية اللي ورا الـLLMs الحديثة: blocks متراصة من attention وfeed-forward بتقرا من residual stream وتكتب فيه، وبتعالج الـtokens بالتوازي.
concepts.failure: Assuming longer input is free; attention cost grows quickly as sequence length increases.

concepts.def_en: A model of connected layers of neurons that multiply inputs by weights, add a bias and apply activations, learning by reducing loss.
concepts.def_ar: الـneural network model من طبقات neurons متوصلة: بتضرب المدخلات في weights وتضيف bias وتطبّق activation، وبتتعلم بتقليل الـloss.
concepts.failure: Believing deeper always wins; without enough data or regularization a bigger network overfits.

concepts.def_en: A non-linear function applied to a neuron's weighted sum, bending the output so stacked l…
concepts.failure: Stacking layers without activations; the whole network collapses into one linear model.

concepts.def_en: A named, reusable block of code that takes inputs, does a calculation and returns a value.
concepts.failure: Forgetting return, so the function silently gives back None.

concepts.def_en: Running inputs through the network layer by layer, multiplying by weights and applying ac…
concepts.failure: Forgetting that the forward pass only predicts; weights change only after loss and backpr…

concepts.def_en: The step size used to update model weights at each training iteration; too small is slow,…
concepts.failure: Setting it too high makes loss blow up; too low looks like training never converges.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
Pulse a target 1-4 times.
Layers of neurons (<= 32 per layer) with forward/backprop pulses.
A formula laid out LTR in an isolate; operators use U+2212 minus; terms can arrive on anchors.
A loss surface with an optimiser path (seeded).
Text broken into tokens that stream past (optionally with ids).
Beams from a focus token to the tokens it attends to.
A token x token attention matrix (<= 16 tokens).
Bars (single or stacked) with token colours; values carry refs.
Dials for sampling parameters (temperature, top-p ...).
Deep-Dive entry card with parent chapter and prerequisite concepts.
